offering_description.value: Provides insurance, memberships, media and an online marketplace for classic, collector and enthusiast car owners. It sells policies and memberships directly to enthusiasts, and runs its valuation, publishing and listing services online and through its agency.

primary_products.value: collector vehicle insurance; enthusiast memberships; automotive publications; online vehicle marketplace

primary_services.value: vehicle valuation; roadside assistance; claims handling; event and travel experiences

customer_segment.value: B2C: classic and collector car owners, car enthusiasts and members of its driving club

end_markets.value: classic and collector cars; automotive insurance; automotive media

revenue_model.value: interest or premiums: insurance premiums on collector vehicle policies; subscription: paid enthusiast membership program; advertising: advertising in its magazine and websites; commissions or management fees: fees on marketplace listings and vehicle sales
revenue_model.category: interest or premiums; subscription; advertising; commissions or management fees

value_chain_position.value: financial intermediary: places and administers insurance policies, sold to vehicle owners; software / platform: online vehicle valuation tools and marketplace, used by enthusiasts and dealers; service provider: membership benefits and roadside assistance, sold to enthusiasts
value_chain_position.category: financial intermediary; software / platform; service provider

geography_served.value: global: US and Canada primarily, with operations in the UK and other markets

specialization.value: related lines: insurance, memberships, publications and online marketplace, all sold to classic car enthusiasts

distribution_channels.value: online: website and app for policies, memberships and marketplace listings; direct sales: phone and in-house agency sales to enthusiasts

regulatory_exposure.value: high: insurance agency and underwriting licensed and regulated by state and national insurance regulators

notes: Geographic footprint beyond the US and Canada is uncertain.
